articles.author: Mohd Haider
articles.headline: SanDisk, Western Digital, Seagate Surge After Hours As Micron's Blowout Earnings Signal Memory Upcycle
articles.summary: SanDisk, Western Digital and Seagate Technology shares surged after hours Wednesday after Micron's strong earnings.
articles._summary: The gains in late trading session reflect a ripple effect, where earnings from a major industry player drive moves in related stocks. Micron’s strong results triggered a sympathy rally in WDC, SNDK and STX, which are exposed to the same demand trends. All three technology stocks reversed intraday losses in after-hours trading following Micron’s results. Trading volume for all three names remained active during the regular session.

articles.author: Ananya Gairola
articles.headline: Micron Didn't Beat Expectations, It 'Annihilated' Them, Says This Analyst: MU Stock Pops Over 15% After Hours
articles.summary: Micron surged over 15% after crushing earnings estimates and forecasting continued strength from booming AI-driven memory demand.
articles._summary: Micron reported third-quarter revenue of $41.46 billion, topping analyst estimates of $35.59 billion, while adjusted earnings came in at $25.11 per share, ahead of expectations for $20.63 per share. Total revenue jumped approximately 346% from a year earlier. The company also issued a strong forecast for the fourth quarter, projecting revenue of $50 billion, plus or minus $1 billion, and adjusted earnings of $31 per share, plus or minus $1.
articles._zh_headline: 这位分析师表示，美光科技没有超出预期，而是“消灭”了预期：盘后，MU 股价上涨超过 15%
articles._zh_summary: 美光公布第三季度营收为 414.6 亿美元，超过分析师预期的 355.9 亿美元，调整后收益为每股 25.11 美元，高于预期的每股 20.63 美元。总收入较上年同期增长约 346%。该公司还发布了第四季度的强劲预测，预计收入为 500 亿美元，上下浮动 10 亿美元，调整后每股收益为 31 美元，上下浮动 1 美元。

articles.author: Erica Kollmann
articles.headline: Micron's Blowout Q3 Report Ripples Through Memory Stocks SanDisk, Western Digital
articles.summary: Memory and storage company Micron Technology (NASDAQ:MU) reports strong Q3 earnings, driving up shares of SanDisk, Western Digital and Seagate.
articles._summary: Investors are reading Micron’s numbers as confirmation that the upcycle in memory, NAND and broader storage demand remains intact, driving a bid into the entire group. Revenue surged to $41.46 billion, far ahead of analyst expectations near $35.6 billion, while adjusted EPS jumped to $25.11, topping forecasts of roughly $20.60 per share, according to Benzinga Pro . Year-over-year revenue growth of about 346% highlights how rapidly demand for high-bandwidth memory and advanced DRAM is hitting the balance sheet.
articles._zh_headline: 美光第三季度井喷报告波及存储股闪迪、西部数据
articles._zh_summary: 投资者将美光的数据视为内存、NAND 和更广泛存储需求的升级周期保持不变的确认，从而推动了对整个集团的收购。根据 Benzinga Pro 的数据，收入飙升至 414.6 亿美元，远远高于分析师近 356 亿美元的预期，而调整后每股收益跃升至 25.11 美元，超过每股约 20.60 美元的预期。收入同比增长约 346%，凸显了对高带宽内存和先进 DRAM 的需求正在迅速影响资产负债表。
